name: context-optimizer
description: Audit and optimize AI context files (copilot-instructions, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, etc.) to reduce token consumption.

contextOptimizer.autoLoadedLineThreshold.description: Maximum recommended lines for auto-loaded context files. Files exceeding this trigger optimization warnings.

contextOptimizer.maxFilesPerPattern.description: Maximum files to match per context pattern during scan. Increase for very large monorepos.

contextOptimizer.excludeGlob.description: Glob pattern used to exclude directories from scans.

chatParticipants.name: context-optimizer
chatParticipants.description: Audit and optimize AI context files to reduce token consumption. Use when: context audit, optimize copilot instructions, reduce tokens, compact instructions, deduplicate context.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Audit all AI context files and report token costs (read-only)

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Show before/after projection without applying changes

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Preview and apply optimized file changes with confirmation

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold optimized context files from your project metadata
